星域是属于我们帝国的区域，能设为自主管理模式，居民可以在他们的权限范围内自行负责£planet£行星上的日常事务。
texts.en:
Our burgeoning empire has now reached a size where it is becoming difficult to administer directly from our homeworld. We should establish a new Sector.

Sectors are areas within our empire that can be set to independently manage the day-to-day affairs of the £planet£ Planets under their jurisdiction.
